name: Pan Sweep
description: Oscillate pan between two endpoints while letting the dimmer breathe along with the motion. Endpoints are DMX fractions (0 = full-left, 0.5 = centre, 1 = full-right) and dimmer values are fractions too (0 = dark, 1 = full). One full back-and-forth takes `seconds` seconds; dimmer linearly follows the pan from `dimmer_a` at `angle_a` to `dimmer_b` at `angle_b` and back.
